subject: Private deployment: VPC pricing, support tiering & platform fee amortization
messages:
From: Claire Adams <claire.adams@starlithealth.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@starlithealth.com, Ben Porter <b.porter@starlithealth.com>
Date: Thu, 7 Aug 2025 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Private deployment pricing — clarifications on platform fee amortization and support tiers

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Procurement had a couple of follow-ups after reviewing the commercial summary: primarily how the platform fee is expected to be invoiced/treated for accounting (capex vs opex), and whether Redwood will entertain a delayed amortization of the platform fee into a monthly schedule to align with our quarter boundaries.

Also: we need a little more color on the three support tiers you outlined (Standard / Premium / Enterprise) — specifically on response SLAs, included oncall hours, and typical onboarding retainer expectations. Our legal and finance teams want concrete numbers they can slot into the SOW.

Attached is our initial SOW (internal markups expected). Could you send a proposal that: (a) shows a 12-month amortized option for the platform fee and a straight upfront option, (b) highlights any implementation credits you can provide if we commit to a 36-month term, and (c) maps support-tier deliverables to explicit response times?

Appreciate your help — we aim to move to procurement signature in the next two weeks if terms align.

Best,
Claire
Claire Adams
Head of Strategic Procurement
Starlit Health
[attachment: Starlit_SOW_draft.pdf (PDF, 124KB)]

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: Claire Adams <claire.adams@starlithealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 7 Aug 2025 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment pricing — clarifications on platform fee amortization and support tiers

Hi Claire — thanks for the clear ask and the SOW. Sending an initial options summary below; I'll follow up with a one-page pricing table and a revised SOW tracked for your review by EOD tomorrow.

Summary (high level):
- Platform fee: we can offer either (1) upfront platform fee invoiced at signature, or (2) amortized over 12 months with a modest service-finance uplift (2% APR equivalent baked into the monthly schedule). Amortization beyond 12 months (e.g., 24–36 months) is possible but would require a financing approval and a small fee (typical market uplift 4–6% total).
- Implementation credits: for a 36-month committed term we can apply an implementation credit equal to 10% of the platform fee (applied as a one-time credit at kickoff).
- Support tiers (examples):
  * Standard: 9x5 email support, 48-hour P1 response SLA, included onboarding retainer: 40 hours.
  * Premium: 24x7 email + phone for P1, 4-hour P1 response SLA, included onboarding retainer: 120 hours, quarterly health checks.
  * Enterprise: Premium + named on-call engineer, 1-hour P1 response SLA, runbook creation, incident bridge coverage, prioritized roadmap slots (limited).

We will capture exact wording/SLAs in the SOW and include pricing permutations in the CSV. If you want, we can propose a staged payment: 50% of platform fee at signature, remainder amortized over 12 months (this can help your quarter planning).

I'll loop in Marissa to confirm discount guardrails and Priyom on finance approvals for extended amortization.

Best,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
[attachment: vpc-pricing-option-sheet.csv]

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 7 Aug 2025 13:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment pricing — internal: discount guardrails & amortization ask

Rishi / Priyom — quick notes from pricing ops:

- Field-level discount authority: sales reps can approve up to 12% total off list for platform + support combined. Anything >12% requires manager sign-off (Marissa) and >18% requires Head of Sales or finance approval. If Starlit asks for 10% off platform fee plus 10% off support, that's 20% total and will need escalation.
- Implementation credit: approved up to 10% for multi-year (36m) deals; finance will offset against recognized revenue per our ASC guidance. Make sure to clearly label it as a one-time kickoff credit in the SOW.
- Amortization: 12-month amortization is product-marketable and low-friction. 24–36 month financing needs a finance memo; Priyom, can you confirm expected uplift if we allow 24 months? My note: ~4.5% total uplift.
- Support tiers: please use the standard SLA table in PRICING_REPO (link below) — but call out that Enterprise requires a minimum of a two-node dedicated pool for on-call guarantee; otherwise we need a labor add-on.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sr. Pricing Manager, Redwood Inference

[Reference: internal PRICING_REPO/rules_vpc_support.md]

From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 8 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment pricing — internal: finance input on amortization

Team — finance confirms the numbers:

- 12-month amortization: approved; no uplift if we treat as monthly invoicing (we book revenue monthly).
- 24-month: finance uplift ~3.8% nominal (we'd need an internal memo and require customer acceptance of a finance schedule).
- 36-month: uplift ~5.0%; acceptable for strategic deals but requires headcount-led approval if implementation credit is taken (we need to ensure revenue deferral doesn't create an operational hit).

Operational ask: if Starlit wants implementation credit + 36-month amortization, add a condition: minimum 24x7 support (Premium) and a 12-month minimum committed capacity (node reservation) — helps protect marginal cost.

I'll prepare a one-page finance note for signatures if you want to proceed.

Priyom
Priyom Das
Head of Revenue Finance, Redwood Inference

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: Claire Adams <claire.adams@starlithealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 12 Aug 2025 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment pricing — clarifications on platform fee amortization and support tiers

Hi Claire — appreciate the patience. Attached is a short proposal that reflects the options we discussed and the guardrails from pricing/finance. TL;DR options are below and the attached CSV has the line-item math for each permutation.

Options (summary):
1) Upfront platform fee (single invoice) + Standard support: baseline pricing.
2) 50% at signature / 50% amortized monthly over 12 months (no uplift) + Premium support: recommended for quarter-alignment.
3) 36-month commitment: 10% implementation credit applied at kickoff; amortization over 36 months permitted with ~5% uplift — requires executive approval and Premium support minimum + 12-month committed capacity.

Discount note: we can offer up to 12% total discount without escalation. Any total economic concession above 12% will need Manager sign-off; >18% needs Head of Sales/Finance approval.

Next steps:
- If option 2 or 3 looks attractive, I can issue a tracked SOW with the exact SLA table and a DocuSign link for signature.
- Attached: vpc-pricing-option-sheet.csv (line items) and a redlined SOW draft.

DocuSign (sample proposal): https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abcdef-123456
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/rdw-RDW-2025-0627-STL

Let me know which option you want me to put on the SOW. Happy to jump on a 20-min call to walk through numbers.

Best,
Rishi

Redwood Inference
